name: Tina media exact-origin CORS boundary
description: The R2 media API resolves TINA_MEDIA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS (with MEDIA_ALLOWED_ORIGINS compatibility), rejects non-allowlisted origins, applies CORS headers through a shared response helper on success/error paths, and keeps Tina authorization on every route including preflight.

outcomes.notes: Current media handlers preserve exact-origin allowlisting, shared CORS behavior, and Tina authorization across media routes and preflight.
outcomes.test_results: npm test 43/43; R2 media CORS contract tests passed.
